title: nan
authors: Cao Y.; Zhang C.; He X.; He P.; Wang T.; Chen Y.
key_contribution: Presents a unified voxel-centric LiDAR-visual-inertial SLAM framework for large-scale GNSS-denied environments, evaluated at kilometer scale.
